WITH base AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS b FROM sentimentandfundamentals),
combo AS (
  SELECT s.transref AS transref, t.tradekind AS tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avgopt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord r ON s.transref = r.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind
),
dev AS (
  SELECT c.transref, c.tradekind, c.avgopt, c.avgopt - base.b AS deviation
  FROM combo c, base
),
typeavg AS (
  SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) AS avgdev FROM dev WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tradekind
),
kept AS (
  SELECT d.tradekind, d.avgopt, d.deviation, d.deviation - ta.avgdev AS excess
  FROM dev d JOIN typeavg ta ON d.tradekind = ta.tradekind
  WHERE d.deviation > ta.avgdev
)
SELECT tradekind, AVG(avgopt) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess
FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind
